newsitem.title: USA: Marriott says to add 120,000 rooms in 5 yrs.
newsitem.headline: Marriott says to add 120,000 rooms in 5 yrs.

text.p: Marriott International Inc said it plans to add 120,000 hotel rooms across its lodging brands over the next five years.
About 21,000 of those rooms are expected to open in 1997, the company said, and a total of 40,000 of the rooms are already under construction or approved for development.
According to the company's chairman, J.W. Marriott, the company sees "continued strong growth" in 1997.
"Our businesses are leaders within their respective industries, and we have the financial strength and investment capacity to pursue opportunities worldwide," he said in a press statement.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment further.
